arguments.value: Lot of (2) 2013 Ski-Doo Tundra Xtrem GLDA snowmobiles with 600HO ETEC engines, offered in repairable condition for parts or restoration. Both units have extensive damage and numerous missing components, including cracked or broken body panels, damaged hoods and windshields, with one showing exposed engine components. Track and suspension components are present. Sold as-is, where-is.
